messages:
kevin: Running into flaky 401s in Cloudflare Workers when using the ESM SDK. Only on retries, first request OK. Anyone seen this?

isabel: Yep. Usually header cloning is the culprit. Workers want a fresh Headers instance; reusing the same header object (or serializing it poorly) can drop Authorization on replay.

mike: Also check that the packaged bundle doesn't accidentally pull in node polyfills. That changes how Headers/Request behave. We should provide an explicit edge entrypoint.

kevin: Quick repro: import 'redwood'; const c=new Redwood({apiKey:RW_KEY}); addEventListener('fetch', e=>e.respondWith(c.generate({prompt:'x'}))) — retry path fails.

isabel: Short-term hack: before calling SDK, create headers = new Headers(req.headers); headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${RW_KEY}`); and pass a fetch wrapper that uses that headers object.

mike: Long-term: change retry serializer to persist header entries (Array.from(headers)) and on replay do new Headers(entries). Also build dist/edge with no node shims and add an exports map for ./runtime.edge.

ci-bot: Created ticket RW-1234 and started CI for branch fix/edge-headers (build 205).

kevin: Thanks — will patch our worker with the hack and follow the PR.
